attempts.raw: {"risk": 5, "reason": "This removes public obsolete virtual methods (e.g. Display(TPart), Edit(TSection), UpdateAsync(TField, IUpdateModel, ...)) from base display driver classes, which is a breaking API change for any downstream module/theme that still overrides these legacy overloads instead of the newer context-based ones, silently breaking their part/field/section display and update logic (since default fallback now returns null instead of invoking the old override)."}
